## Invitations

A total of 6866 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 4270, representing a response rate of 62.2 per cent. This provides an overview of engagement with the outreach offer and indicates that a substantial proportion of those invited took part.

Outreach arrangements were maintained across North City, with van days continuing where road conditions allowed. The team adjusted local activity to support access and keep planned contact opportunities available.

## Contact

SMS was used alongside the invitations, with 5794 invitations sent by this method. No reminder messages were issued: the recorded reminder total was 0. The contact approach therefore relied on the initial invitation and SMS communication, with attendance monitored against the number invited.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
